annual_fee.note: Unchanged by the 2026-06-15 refresh; the original effective date of the current $95 fee was not found.

benefits.name: Chase Travel hotel credit
benefits.qualifying: Hotel accommodation booked through Chase Travel; the credited portion does not earn points.
benefits.note: Per account anniversary year. Typically posts in about 3 business days; allow up to 4 weeks. Older sources say $50; current Chase terms support $100. Older sources say $50; current Chase terms say $100 per anniversary year. The catalog vouches only for terms from 2026-06-15.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit
benefits.qualifying: Eligible application fee charged to the card.
benefits.note: Up to $120, available once every 4 years. Allow 1-2 billing cycles for the credit.

benefits.name: Apple TV subscription
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Apple TV subscription; detailed terms give an $8 a month Apple One adjustment for qualifying existing subscribers.
benefits.note: One complimentary year, not a replenishing annual credit. Chase advertises a $180 value and other sources use different dollar estimates; the real benefit is a year of subscription access, not $180 in cash or a statement credit.

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.enrollment_how: Link and activate an eligible card by 2029-12-31.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible DoorDash and Caviar orders; minimums apply.
benefits.note: Runs through 2029-12-31, or 12 months from activation if that is longer, under the detailed terms. Older pages say 2027.

benefits.name: DoorDash nonrestaurant discount
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active eligible DashPass; apply the promotion.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible groceries, retail and other nonrestaurant orders.
benefits.note: Calendar month, no rollover. Applied at checkout, not as a statement credit.

benefits.name: Lyft partner earnings
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Lyft products and services: 5x total points.

benefits.name: Peloton partner earnings
benefits.qualifying: Eligible equipment and accessory purchases over $150: 5x total points on up to $5,000, 25,000 total points.
benefits.note: An offer-period limit, not an annual cap. Chase supports 25,000 total points: 20,000 incremental plus 5,000 base points; '25,000 bonus points' is imprecise. Paid as Ultimate Rewards points.

benefits.name: Legacy anniversary bonus (final payout)
benefits.qualifying: Applicable pre-refresh accounts and eligible purchases through the cutoff: 10% of eligible purchase dollars, paid as points.
benefits.note: Earning ended 2026-10-01; the final payout is due by 2027-01-31 for eligible legacy accounts. Older reviews describe an ongoing 10% annual benefit.

benefits.name: Points Boost / transfer access
benefits.enrollment_how: Use the Chase Travel or transfer flow.
benefits.qualifying: Selected travel offers and transfer partners; redemption value varies.
benefits.note: Transfers to Hyatt are 4 Chase points to 3 Hyatt points from 2026-10-01; older sources show 1:1.

thresholds.unlocks: 5x total points on up to $5,000 of eligible Peloton purchases during the offer period (25,000 total points); an earning limit, not an annual benefit.

upcoming_changes.summary: Deadline for the final legacy anniversary-bonus points payout to eligible legacy accounts.
